title: Investigate backend T1 nightly run failure during restart ptf
author: neethajohn
body:
09/09 test run failed with the following error

TASK [vm_set : Renumber topology t1-backend to VMs. base vm = VM1884] **********
Thursday 09 September 2021  12:08:28 +0000 (0:00:00.041)       0:00:39.947 **** 
fatal: [STR2-ACS-SERV-18]: FAILED! => {"changed": false, "msg": "ret_code=1, error message=\"Cannot find device \"b3f539mgmt\"\n\". cmd=\"nsenter -t 42251 -n ip link set b3f539mgmt up\""}
